evidence.snippet: Michael: Oh, OK. Why didn't you call me?

beats.summary: Jan introduces her baby Astrid to the office and Michael awkwardly holds her.

evidence.snippet: Michael (cradling the car seat awkwardly): All right, OK.

beats.summary: Dwight mocks the expensive stroller by comparing its cost to his bomb shelter and tests its durability humorously.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Twelve hundred dollars is what I spent on my whole bomb shelter.
Dwight (throwing the stroller against a high chain link fence): Don't get stuck on the barbed wire!

beats.summary: Michael organizes baby shower games and gift opening despite Kevin's concerns.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Ready to play some games? Let's do it!

beats.summary: Jan describes her tub birth experience and the afterbirth, causing discomfort among coworkers.

evidence.snippet: Jan: Well, actually, I, uh, I had a tub birth.
